issues.explanation: Chapter 36 says Liu Bei immediately sets out for Nanyang with Guan Yu and Zhang Fei, but Chapter 37 places him still preparing gifts when Sima Hui arrives, before the first visit. The source sequence has Liu Bei preparing to go, not already departing.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the closing to say Liu Bei returned to Xinye and prepared gifts, intending to visit Zhuge Liang with Guan Yu and Zhang Fei.
